# Assessment Supplementary Documents

This directory contains the supplementary documents generated for the ServiceFabric assessment. Some application-layer inventories report that source code is outside this deployment-only scope.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) — Deployment-level architecture and component relationships for the three guest-container services.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) — Declared NuGet build dependency inventory and compatibility observations.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) — Endpoint inventory status; no API endpoint source is present in the ServiceFabric deployment scope.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) — Data access/model inventory status; no data access layer or entity source is present in the deployment scope.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) — Service Fabric manifest parameters, profiles, runtime settings, and masked secret references.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) — Business workflow inventory status; application business logic is outside the deployment scope.
